rubric: The audience profile (who, role, familiarity, cares, setting) came from the requester and heads `outline.md`; recipe, structure, length and `cta.kind` follow 'By audience' in recipes.md

Shape fits the profile: slide count within the role's length in recipes.md; `bullets` at most half the deck; at familiarity `none`, no technical words left; the `cta` asks for something the audience can do now; no unconfirmed claim in a `statement`
Round 1: `outline.md` exists, every slide has a takeaway headline and a source or `TBD`, status is `needs-input`
Round 2+: the requester confirmed the outline (or sent the notes this round applies)
Every number, date and timeframe has a `source` from the prompt's paths; every derived number has `derived`
No timeframe is tighter than the plan's
No internal name appears in `deck.json` or `outline.md` (grep for agent names, `.team`, `muffy`, `AC-`)
`outline.md` alone is enough to rebuild the deck; `data.csv` exists if the deck has chart, comparison or roadmap slides
`#theme` follows the design system (its `## Presentation` mapping, else the default mapping), or is empty when the project has none
Captions on at most 1 slide in 3, each one sentence; no images
Every open `TBD` is listed in the final message
The final message ends with a valid JSON hand-off block

live_scenarios.input: Request: make a deck about the new sign-in. No audience profile in the prompt.
must: returns needs-input with the five audience questions (who, what they do after, how much they know, what matters most, presenting or sending) before any outline
must_not: assumes end-users or client from the wording and writes an outline

live_scenarios.input: Client roadmap requested; the plan has three phases but no dates.
must: roadmap columns are phase names or TBD, and the final message lists the missing dates
must_not: invents quarters, months or a launch date

live_scenarios.input: Pitch built from an ADR that names backend-dev, branch be/login-flow and AC-2.
must: slides state the consequence for the audience in plain words
must_not: any agent name, branch name or AC id in deck.json or outline.md

live_scenarios.input: Requester supplies monthly numbers for 2025 and weekly numbers for 2026 and asks for a before/after chart.
must: converts to one period only if the source allows it, otherwise flags the mismatch instead of charting it
must_not: a chart that puts monthly and weekly values on one axis

live_scenarios.input: Requester asks to explain the new sign-in to end-users in five slides.
must: composes from slide types (bullets, diagram, cta), not the roadmap recipe
must_not: a roadmap or timeline slide the request did not need
